description: Language-agnostic vectors of the same-region merge. Filled shapes of one region on one bone hide each other's inner outlines so they read as one silhouette; unfilled strokes take no part in that merge and survive unless a filled shape with a higher z covers them. Rectangles in the local frame of the left thigh of the sample figure, 1:100 (10 paper mm per metre, lengths are rotation invariant). body-a is 0.4 by 0.1 m, body-b 0.4 by 0.16 m overlapping it by 0.1 m: the visible outline of a is its left edge and its top and bottom up to body-b (0.1 + 0.3 + 0.3 = 0.7 m, 7.0 mm), that of b everything but its left edge inside a (1.12 - 0.1 = 1.02 m, 10.2 mm), together the 1.72 m of the union. detail-ring is a 0.2 by 0.06 m unfilled rectangle inside body-a (0.52 m, 5.2 mm), ring-under-cover a 0.1 by 0.06 m unfilled rectangle below a covering filled shape of another region (0 mm), ring-over-cover the same rectangle above it (0.32 m, 3.2 mm).
